lede: Alabama carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.7 against +4.1, a 5.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tennessee +6.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Alabama winning 66% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is linebackers, where Alabama leads Tennessee by 104 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
